acceptanceCriteria.text: Document the distinction between Deployment Golden Path (`R4 -> R3 -> R2 -> R1`) and Runtime correctness boundary (`R3 -> R2 -> R1`).
Preserve Route 4 as the mandatory fresh-host entry point for the current supported deployment profile.
Define the seven-layer certification ladder and what each layer proves or intentionally does not prove.
Define Route 3 as the provider-independent convergence boundary consumed by Lima/QEMU and future providers.
Link the Wave 0 correctness blockers required before another #261 run.
Add/adjust repository architecture documentation so #232, ADR-0003, and #261 use consistent terminology.
Require Route 3 -> 2 -> 1 certification and Lima provider certification to pass before the next #261 real-host run.

issue.title: refactor(runtime): split runtime correctness from deployment certification
